_execution_note: Measured on apollo (32 cores, RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, CUDA 13.0): training 3 epochs of hierarchy_physics on 2592 train + 864 validation records took 34.31 s at 1 thread, 34.90 s at 4 and 34.67 s at 8. Threading buys nothing because the workload is dispatch-bound on graphs of at most ten nodes, so a GPU is not expected to help either and was not used. Generation measured 20.45 accepted labels/s on CuPy against 18.93 on NumPy (1.08x) with 1.22e-15 outcome parity, and CuPy is capped at one parent worker, so NumPy with many workers wins there too. PROPOSALS VARIANT: the decomposition measured on seed 0 found the direct policy limited by BOTH ranking (regret 0.015-0.021, Spearman 0.50-0.62 on its own proposals) and generation (best-of-3 still 0.023 behind bank selection). Three proposal heads is the binding constraint on the generation side, so this variant raises it to sixteen and changes nothing else.
